verdict.rationale: Bulk triage is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers per-message Graph API operations (update, flag, categories) and automated Inbox rules. Nothing documents selecting many conversations at once and archiving, labeling, or marking them done in one action. Rules and per-message API calls are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
